synthesis_steps.title: Catalyst Preparation
synthesis_steps.description: In a glove box under inert atmosphere (nitrogen or argon), prepare the Ziegler-Natta catalyst system by combining TiCl4 and TEA in anhydrous hexane. Stir for 30 minutes at room temperature to activate the catalyst.

synthesis_steps.title: Reactor Setup
synthesis_steps.description: Transfer the catalyst solution to a 1L stainless steel autoclave reactor. Purge the reactor with nitrogen three times to remove all oxygen and moisture.
synthesis_steps.equipment: 1L autoclave reactor with pressure gauge and temperature control

synthesis_steps.title: Monomer Addition and Polymerization
synthesis_steps.description: Cool the reactor to 0°C. Add the monomer mixture (propylene and comonomers) slowly through a pressure-regulated feed line. Heat the reactor to 60-70°C and maintain pressure at 5-10 bar. Allow polymerization to proceed for 4-6 hours with continuous stirring (300 rpm).
synthesis_steps.equipment: Autoclave with temperature and pressure control, overhead stirrer

synthesis_steps.title: Quenching and Precipitation
synthesis_steps.description: After polymerization is complete, cool the reactor to room temperature and carefully vent excess pressure. Add 500 mL of acidified methanol (1% HCl) to quench the catalyst and precipitate the polymer. Stir for 1 hour.

synthesis_steps.title: Purification
synthesis_steps.description: Filter the precipitated polymer through a Buchner funnel. Wash thoroughly with methanol (3 × 200 mL) to remove catalyst residues, then with deionized water (2 × 200 mL). Dry the polymer in a vacuum oven at 60°C for 24 hours.

synthesis_steps.title: Post-Processing (Optional)
synthesis_steps.description: For improved properties, the dried polymer can be melt-blended with stabilizers and antioxidants using a twin-screw extruder at 180-200°C. Pelletize the extrudate for injection molding.

safety_notes: All polymerization reactions must be conducted in a well-ventilated fume hood.
Organometallic catalysts (TiCl4, TEA) are highly reactive with moisture and oxygen. Handle only in inert atmosphere.
Monomers are flammable and may be toxic. Use appropriate PPE (gloves, safety glasses, lab coat).
High-pressure reactors require proper training and safety protocols.
Dispose of all chemical waste according to institutional guidelines.

verification_protocol.purpose: Confirm functional groups and chemical structure
verification_protocol.acceptance_criteria: Spectrum matches expected functional groups based on composition

verification_protocol.purpose: Determine polymer microstructure and comonomer incorporation
verification_protocol.method: ¹H NMR and ¹³C NMR in CDCl₃ or d₆-DMSO
verification_protocol.expected_signals: Signals consistent with propylene backbone and comonomer units
verification_protocol.acceptance_criteria: Integration ratios match expected composition within ±5%
Thermal transitions within ±10°C of predicted values

verification_protocol.method: Injection-molded dog-bone specimens, tested at 23°C, 50% RH, 50 mm/min strain rate
verification_protocol.expected_results: Tensile Strength ≥ 461 MPa, Elongation at Break ≈ 80%
verification_protocol.acceptance_criteria: Tensile strength within ±15% of predicted value
Hardness within ±5 Shore D units of predicted value

verification_protocol.purpose: Assess thermal stability and decomposition temperature
verification_protocol.expected_results: Onset of decomposition > 300°C, 5% weight loss temperature > 350°C
verification_protocol.acceptance_criteria: Thermal stability suitable for processing at 180-200°C
